item.title: Export and Migrate Graph Data with SeaTunnel Source
item.description: If you need to copy data from one HugeGraph graph to another, use graph2graph: HugeGraph Source reads vertices and edges from the source graph (graph A), and HugeGraph Sink writes them to the target graph (graph B), with an optional Transform in between. The data path is graph A → HugeGraph Source → (optional Transform) → HugeGraph Sink → graph B. If you need to export graph data to a file, JDBC, Kafka, or another system, use graph2any, where a downstream Sink receives the records read by HugeGraph Source. This page covers both job types.
